mapper.select: SELECT job_details.JOB_NAME as jobName, job_details.JOB_GROUP as jobGroup, job_details.JOB_CLASS_NAME as jobClassName, cron_triggers.CRON_EXPRESSION as cronExpression, cron_triggers.TIME_ZONE_ID as timeZoneId, qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_NAME as triggerName, qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_GROUP as triggerGroup, qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_STATE as triggerState, COALESCE(simple_triggers.REPEAT_INTERVAL, 0) as repeatInterval, COALESCE(simple_triggers.TIMES_TRIGGERED, 0) as timesTriggered FROM QRTZ_JOB_DETAILS job_details LEFT JOIN QRTZ_TRIGGERS qrtz_triggers ON qrtz_triggers.JOB_NAME = job_details.JOB_NAME AND qrtz_triggers.JOB_GROUP = job_details.JOB_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_CRON_TRIGGERS cron_triggers ON cron_triggers.TRIGGER_NAME = qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_NAME AND cron_triggers.TRIGGER_GROUP = qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_GROUP LEFT JOIN QRTZ_SIMPLE_TRIGGERS simple_triggers ON simple_triggers.TRIGGER_NAME = qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_NAME AND simple_triggers.TRIGGER_GROUP = qrtz_triggers.TRIGGER_GROUP ORDER BY job_details.JOB_NAME, job_details.JOB_GROUP
